## Goal
- v1.10.22 shipped (owner sign-in 3-defect fix). NEW task from user video: after Sign-In the Home screen goes black — audit home route line-by-line, QA line-by-line, fix, and ship v1.10.23 end-to-end with certificate.

## Constraints & Preferences
- GitHub repo `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`; PAT recoverable from Render: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer rnd_1H0XCquMZQTRyAnHgbEv8dVWYPVs" "https://api.render.com/v1/services/srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0/env-vars?limit=100"` → `GITHUB_TOKEN`; cache at `/tmp/gh_tok`.
- Sandbox restarts wipe `~/.android/debug.keystore`; regenerate: `keytool -genkeypair -v -keystore ~/.android/debug.keystore -storepass android -alias androiddebugkey -keypass android -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10950 -dname "CN=Android Debug,O=Android,C=US"`.
- Release payloads must be written to `.tmp-relXX.json` file (inline heredocs mangle quotes); delete after.
- `multiEdit` fails "You can't edit a file that you have not read" — always `read` in-session first.
- Video attachments: download, `ffprobe` duration, extract frames `ffmpeg -vf "fps=2"`, per-region brightness via `crop=iw:ih*0.06:0:0,scale=1:1 -pix_fmt gray` (statusbar/middle/navbar separately).
- User demands line-by-line audit, QA evidence, certificate, live proof. Execution evidence only.

## Progress
### Done
- **v1.10.22 SHIPPED & VERIFIED**: release_id 373202586, tag `v1.10.22-qa`, asset `ivx-holdings-v1.10.22.apk` (84,904,272 bytes, SHA256 `4126e19b5f18d6b10bdd77213af0393c6eaea5ee54de445ff9cdb1cfa5477697`), download re-verified HTTP 200 + checksum match. Bundle verified: `1.10.22 (120)` stamp, `invalid_credentials`/`rate_limited`/`verification_required`, retry logging, `Login failed:`, all v1.10.21 layers retained. Gradle BUILD SUCCESSFUL (4m43s + 1m16s rebuild).
- **BUILD_STAMP miss caught**: first v1.10.22 build shipped `1.10.21 (119)` in bundle — `expo/constants/build-stamp.ts` was not bumped; fixed and rebuilt. Always verify stamp in bundle.
- Certificate written: `docs/IVX_OWNER_SIGNIN_ROOT_CAUSE_CERTIFICATE_v1.10.22.md` (full 13-hop logging map, 3 defects, incident audit: 6 certs, 72 auth commits).
- **Video QA decoded** (`erm1138urx26ow1nkznf5.mp4`, 47.86s, 96 frames @2fps): Sign-In tapped frame 060 (t≈30s), **no error alert**, then Phase A (t=31.2–32.7s) brightness 13/10/4 = `#0A0A0F` (`Colors.background`) container painted with **ZERO content**, then Phase B (t=33–48s) pure `#000000` for 15s. No watchdog overlay ever appeared.
- **Home black screen root cause — 2 defects, ALL FIXED**:
  1. **Home tab anchored at a route group**: `app/(tabs)/(home)/` held only `_layout.tsx` + `home.tsx`; a group has no path segment so it can never host `index.tsx` (collides with `app/index.tsx` on `/`) → entry resolution depended solely on anchor string; when it produced nothing: silent dark frame, no error. Fixed: moved `home.tsx` to `app/(tabs)/home.tsx`, deleted `(home)` dir, anchor → leaf `'home'`.
  2. **Watchdog structurally blind after login**: `BlankScreenWatchdog` armed on `hasNeverPainted()` — process-wide one-shot; login's paint permanently disarmed it, so post-login blank screens were undetectable (why no recovery UI appeared in video). Fixed: per-route paint tracking + re-arm on every pathname change.
- **20 files rewritten** replacing `(tabs)/(home)/home` → `(tabs)/home` (app/, components/, lib/, hooks/, __tests__/).
- `app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx`: `anchor: 'home'`, `initialRouteName="home"`, `Tabs.Screen name="home"` (was `(home)`).
- `lib/screen-paint-watchdog.ts` rewritten: `paintedRoutes` Map, `INSTRUMENTED_ROUTES = ['/','/home','/login']`, `normalizeRoute()`, `markScreenPainted()` per route, `isRouteInstrumented()`, `getRoutePaintedAt()`, `hasRouteFailedToPaint(route, enteredAt)`, `resetPaintTracking()`.
- `components/BlankScreenWatchdog.tsx`: uses `hasRouteFailedToPaint(pathname, enteredAt)` + `isRouteInstrumented(pathname)`, `dismissedRouteRef` prevents re-accuse loop, re-arms per route change.
- `app/(tabs)/home.tsx`: `markScreenPainted('/home')` (router pathname, NOT file path — groups carry no segment).
- New guard test `__tests__/home-route-blank-screen.test.ts` (15 tests; comment-stripping added so doc comments don't false-trigger path checks; code-slicing from `import React` for watchdog assertion).
- `__tests__/route-anchor-black-screen.test.ts` updated to new invariants (leaf screen exists, no `(home)` group, anchor target file exists, login targets `/(tabs)/home`).

### In Progress
- `route-anchor-black-screen.test.ts` just edited — **tests not yet re-run** after the update. Last combined run: 39 pass / 4 fail (all 4 were the old group-structure assertions now rewritten).
